notes.title: Tokyo: Passing Through!
notes.notes:
[h2][color="#FFB43D"]BUS at Tokyo Game Show 2025: Getting Ready for a Grand Event![/color][/h2]

[url=https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/en/sns]The Tokyo Game Show[/url] will take place [b]from September 25th to 28th[/b], and this is already the 29th event - a true milestone in the world of gaming events! This year, the official sponsor of the festival is actor Kanata Hongo, who is known for his work on the iconic anime "Attack on Titan" and "Fullmetal Alchemist", while the official artwork was created by the amazing artist [url=https://x.com/warashiz]Zashiki Warashi[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/2b49394bf18185cc227381e03511224ab1d25521.gif[/img]

We are happy to announce that BUS will also be present at this large-scale event. Meanwhile, the development of our game is in full swing, and it's the perfect time to talk about some new boss fights:

[h3]Titan[/h3]
Inspired by "Attack on Titan", our main antagonist has created his own zombie titan. Imagine - a creature hundreds of times larger than you! How to defeat it? That's still a big secret, but believe us - it will be so epic that you will remember this fight forever. Share your theories in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/e779c3f0deff93e47db2ce362550e4489952a4e2.gif[/img]

[h3]The Fabricator Mech[/h3]
This villain from the demo has already managed to win over fans with his cruel character and furious attack style. The engineer's workshop is a place where chaos reigns, and problems with his mechanical arm are just the beginning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/be684d486c57e0d9e6c6c709c4fa1dbb7083f908.gif[/img]

[h3]The Train[/h3]
Not every boss on the island is a creature. One of the powerful opponents will be a train, where each carriage presents a deadly challenge. And you will have to chase it in a school bus. Yes, we also thought: "What could possibly go wrong?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/9c056980331a86a3f8530d2ae28e6f3981014e8c.png[/img]
And while we are busy with development, we have an invitation…

[h3][color="#AAFF00"]Coming soon: Playtest![/color][/h3]
Get ready to hop aboard! In a few days registration for our next playtest will be available. Make sure to keep an eye on our Steam page not to miss it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852700/BUS_Bro_u_Survived
Lucky survivors will try out the new, improved demo version of the game.

And if you want to look behind the scenes of development and see how concepts are born, make sure to follow us on Twitter and other social networks:

notes.title: The very moment when everything could have gone wrong...
notes.notes:
[h1]"These guys aren't aliens. Those are zombies!"[/h1]

[b][color="#FFB43D"]Hello Survivors![/color][/b]

Our initial idea with zombies involved a collective mind. We considered two options:

[*] Zombies that stick various iron objects into their heads, which function like antennas.
[*] Zombies with transparent heads that would glow when their relatives appeared nearby.

The more zombies present, the brighter the light. Imagine what a [strike]cool[/strike] zombie party that would be! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/6e5b484983d296e0bb1b40841bb2427534064d50.png"][/img]

Later, we decided to abandon the idea of visually representing their connection. However, the concept of a single mind remained.

We then began to work on the design of the zombies themselves, starting small - [u]literally[/u]:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/622770b912198afc40643554acfade944301ec44.png"][/img]

We came up with silly zombie babies[strike] (Zombaby)[/strike]. This happened because we aimed to create a design that wasn't too realistic, adding jelly-like features and plumpness to the monsters. Simultaneously, a taller version was drawn, with faces resembling those of evil old men.

The second option looked better, except for the heads. They were replaced by skeletons:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/9ec4c9ba09af9a9292e9b2ee8603e5405bbf89ab.png"][/img]

Everyone liked this design, and it was chosen as the main one for our definitely-not-aliens. If you have any ideas or suggestions for their appearance, we welcome you to share them on our social networks!

[b][color="#FFB43D"]See you at the next stop![/color][/b]

notes.title: Let's look under the hood!
notes.notes: [h3]Why a bus?[/h3][p]At the beginning of our project, we wanted to include a large and roomy vehicle that would appear ironic in a zombie apocalypse world and match our style.[/p][p]We chose a bus. And what is the most stylish and recognizable bus that comes to mind? That's right—a school bus :)[/p][p]                                                                       First concepts   [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/1fe97de9e11a9b995a33f0983f457e94f0ff5933.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/74f563eb6262519935c23352f083cffe5bb7a4f6.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Naturally, we also thought about customizing the bus. Is it even possible to create a vehicle without the ability to add spoilers, saws, or bat wings to it?![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]                                                       One of the first customization concepts  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/b1ecdadb330709f468632dac2756ec135243fc49.png"][/img][/p][p]You may have already experienced the bus customization in the latest demo. Meanwhile, we continue to develop even more decorations and visual enhancements for the bus. Here's a small spoiler of what we're planning:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/e01dfc48302fc174531ff8740b84271d70ab020c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/835695e1722b9fc5ba0256bdbd628642ed5ee35f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/9a68b01bcdd91ca4ca39acf903420d4f24224ca3.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Due to its perfect fit with our setting and concept, the bus became the foundation of our project and the main symbol that will be your most loyal friend throughout the game (you wouldn't trade it for a mustang, would you?).[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any ideas for the bus's appearance, feel free to reach out to us on social media. We will consider the most interesting suggestions and, if possible, implement them![/p]

notes.title: We got answers!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/bb313edf885f2c3442dac74fb5eafa0a321f902d.jpg[/img]

We’ve gathered the most talked-about questions about our game for you, from zombies and robots to technical details!

[h3]How many locations are in the game?[/h3]
A: The game features over 10 story-driven missions and approximately 6-7 endless missions. These endless missions focus on looting, defeating special enemies, and liberating territories.

[h3]How long will it take to complete the game?[/h3]
A: The main storyline offers around 30 hours of gameplay. However, to fully experience all the content, including side missions and unlockables, you’ll need significantly more time.

[h3]Is this only a story-driven game?[/h3]
A: Not at all! In addition to the story mode, where you uncover the island's mysteries and influence its fate, we also offer free-roam missions. These allow you to explore the world at your own pace and take on various challenges. You’ll also need to develop your base, which serves as the starting point for both story missions and open-world exploration!

[h3]Are there enemies other than zombies?[/h3]
A: Yes! While zombies are a major part of the game, we’ve introduced other enemy types as well. For example, we’ve already showcased fights with robotic enemies during development. There are also other unique foes that we’ll reveal later - stay tuned!

[h3]Can I adjust the difficulty level?[/h3]
A: The difficulty is tied to the missions themselves. Some missions are designed to be more challenging, while others are easier. You can choose which missions to tackle based on your preferred difficulty. Additionally, we have a matchmaking system for teaming up with random players. However, we highly recommend playing with friends for the best experience! If you’re looking for teammates, join our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5tBE3VY]Discord channel[/url] - it’s a great place to find like-minded players.

[h3]Can I play solo?[/h3]
A: Absolutely! Our game dynamically adjusts to the number of players in your session. If you’re playing alone, the world and content will adapt to provide a tailored single-player experience. Similarly, if you’re playing with three or four players, the game will scale accordingly to ensure a balanced and enjoyable experience for everyone.

[b]Soon will be more news about updates and demo version, stay tuned and ask your questions in our Discord channel![/b]
